d: As Europe gears up for the Christmas holiday season, the United States has issued a broad security warning for Americans travelling across the continent. At least 11 US embassies have urged citizens to remain vigilant at crowded tourist destinations, Christmas markets, transport hubs and public gatherings, citing the risk of terrorist attacks, including lone-wolf incidents. The advisories also flag hoax bomb threats targeting civil aviation, as well as potential travel disruptions caused by strikes and demonstrations. But is this merely a precautionary alert, or does Washington have deeper…
